rows.label: tlk70000064_01_msg0001
rows.name:
Punpun has been to Iira's capital
just once, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000064_01_msg0002
rows.name:
It was a lovely city. The shopping
district was lively, and the beautiful
gardens really stood out, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000064_01_msg0003
rows.name:
And more than anything...
Adventurers, Drivers, and Blades...

rows.label: tlk70000064_01_msg0004
rows.name:
Everyone lived together in harmony,
which made pacifist Punpun feel right
at home, mo!
